Dallas Electronics Fan
4.0 out of 5 stars Strong suction, ergonomic. Filter will need frequent cleaning. Problematic marketing..
Reviewed in the United States on July 16, 2023
Color: SlateVerified Purchase
Consumer Reports was my first stop before purchasing this. They're a great first step before purchasing a category of product you have no experience with. This is a CR top pick. Vacuum Wars is also good resource.

Side note: Immediately after unpacking and before charging, remove the filter housing and look at the label that lies underneath. There appears to be 3-4 versions (more?) of the WV201, all advertised as the WV201 in the primary advertising.

I have two of these. One of the hidden labels ID's the model number as 'WV201 14' and the other 'WV201 U4'. They are virtually identical in external appearance.

The docks are likewise identical externally but have different wall warts.

Short take:

Truly powerful suction for a cordless hand held. Sophisticated external design. Ergonomically excellent. Great product. After ~15 months of usage, very happy customer.

Long take.

Probably stating the obvious, this is a great product in its swim lane but it won't replace a more capable vac with a larger ingress point, larger tank and more power.

The filter should be cleaned frequently, significantly more so than larger vacs with larger tanks and filters which are more forgiving about the frequency of cleaning. I usually remove the filter and tap it out over a sink after about 4-5 uses.

Step 1: release the tank access door so it is fully open.
Step 2: With interlocked or overlapping fingers, cup the vac in both hands so the open tank is facing you.
Step 3: use both thumbs to push the filter housing out and into the tank.
Step 4: remove the filter housing from the tank.
Step 5: remove the filter from the filter housing.

The filter that ships with this Shark is HEPA compliant. This is unusual for cordless hand vacs. The Vacuum Wars site did roundup of 15 cordless hand vacs in 2021. Only four did well with the HEPA test.

Bottom line, great product. Definitely recommended. In my experience, it's become one of those products that I wouldn't want to be without. Max convenience, time saving and high performing. Nice work Shark.

4.0 out of 5 stars It's okay, battery life is a bit shorter than I was hoping for.
Reviewed in the United States on May 7, 2026
Color: SlateVerified Purchase
This wandvac is replacing a decade or so old handvac that's runtime was down to about ~15 seconds on a full charge. This Shark wandvac is okay. It has less suction than I was hoping, and battery life is only around 10 minutes of runtime before it requires a recharge.

Assembly was easy, and it's easy enough to use. But it could do with about 30% more suction power and about 50% more battery life.
